title: Green wordmark cap
slide_intent: Test an identity with very few elements because some merchandise needs immediate recognition from one mark and one color.
strategic_value: The white wordmark on a green cap can carry Duolingo’s signature beyond screens.
demonstration: A green cap is shown front-on with the white wordmark across its front panel.
practical_value: Evaluate wordmark contrast and placement on a curved fabric surface.

content_islands.name: Cap
content_islands.spec: Center the green cap against a pale background.

content_islands.name: Front signature
content_islands.spec: Keep the white wordmark across the front panel above the brim.

reference_purposes.Application: The cap visualization demonstrates a single wordmark on a branded-color object.
